caption: The drawing depicts a single, round bowl with a wide rim at the top center of the composition, rendered in shades of gray pencil on a yellowed or off-white background. The bowl features a decorative handle at its upper side, consisting of two symmetrical fish-like figures facing outward, with an ornate shield or crest between them and a small circular loop at the very top. The shading indicates depth and curvature on the bowl’s interior and exterior surfaces. The entire bowl and handle are framed within a lightly sketched rectangular border. Beneath the main drawing, there is a smaller inset diagram showing a cross-sectional side view of the bowl with numerical annotations for dimensions. The signature "Charles Cullen" appears in cursive to the right of this diagram. There are no other depicted objects or colors aside from the gray tones used for shading and definition.
title: Pewter Porringer
